note: Family-owned RV park on US-515 S near Ellijay, open since 1997; mountain views, fire ring at each site, pavilion with a guest lounge, playground, cottages, camp hosts on site. A limited number of extended-stay sites go to people building homes locally or on temporary jobs. Not on water (Carters Lake is a nearby attraction only). --Claude
summary: Own site (Google Sites, (c)2024): open year-round, '50+' full-hookup sites (30/50 A, water, sewer), pull-through + back-in, 3 bathhouses with showers, laundry; reservations by phone only; rates not posted (by RV size and electric use). Count 32 (RV Life) -> 50 (operator's '50+'); hookups/season confirmed; facilities and booking added; fees left unset (no posted rate; RV Life $$ / avg $38 stays in rating).
